نتقاوى (form VI)
# نَتَقَاوَى (nataqāwā) /na.ta.qaː.waː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَقَاوَى (taqāwā)
# نُتَقَاوَى (nutaqāwā) /nu.ta.qaː.waː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَقَاوَى (taqāwā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
